 Trade: Jaguars Trade For Saints DT Davon Godchaux
 Originally posted on
 NFLTradeRumors.co 
  | 
 By Logan Ulrich
  | 
 Last updated Nov 9, 2026 1:18 PM ET
 Add us as a preferred source on Google
 According to Tom Pelissero , the Jaguars are acquiring Saints DT Davon Godchaux in a trade. 
 It’s the second deal of the day for Jacksonville after spending big to pry S Jessie Bates from the Falcons.
 Godchaux will almost certainly come considerably cheaper but the Jaguars needed a replacement nose tackle after losing DaVon Hamilton for the season. 
 He restructured his contract with the Saints coming into this season and is on a minimum salary. 
 Godchaux, 31, is a former fifth-round pick of the Dolphins back in 2017 out of LSU. He played out the final year of his four-year, $2.6 million rookie contract. 
 The Patriots signed Godchaux to a two-year deal worth up to $16 million, then signed him to a new two-year, $20.8 million extension after one season.
 Once again, Godchaux signed a two-year extension heading into the 2024 season worth up to $21 million. However, he was traded to the Saints in 2025. 
 In 2026, Godchaux has appeared in eight games for the Saints and recorded 15 total tackles and one tackle for loss.
